# Code of Conduct

## Our Commitment

At AR Corp Solutions, we are committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and harassment-free environment for everyone.

---

## Expected Behavior

* Be respectful and inclusive
* Accept constructive feedback gracefully
* Communicate professionally
* Focus on what is best for the community

---

## Unacceptable Behavior

* Harassment or discrimination of any kind
* Offensive or derogatory comments
* Personal attacks or trolling
* Public or private harassment

---

## Enforcement

Project maintainers are responsible for enforcing this Code of Conduct.

Violations may result in:

* Warning
* Temporary or permanent ban from participation

---

## Reporting Issues

If you experience or witness unacceptable behavior:

📧 Contact: [antonio.russi.consulting@gmail.com](mailto:antonio.russi.consulting@gmail.com)

All reports will be handled confidentially.

---

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies to:

* All repositories
* Issues and pull requests
* Discussions and external communication channels

---

## Acknowledgment

By participating, you agree to follow this Code of Conduct.
